mapper.sql: event_id, receipt_id, same_binding_key, contract_id, journey_id, server_binding_id, tenant_subject_digest, event_type, sequence_no, occurred_at, product_id, package_id, agent_name, marketplace, listed_surface, listed_manifest_version, embedded_contract_version, host_client_family, host_version, terminal, channel, request_source, intent_signal, intent_family, classification_source, classifier_version, confidence_bucket, review_mode, traffic_class, traffic_authority, outcome, previous_event_digest, traceparent, canonical_digest, event_digest, signer_key_id, signature_hex, nonce_hash, issued_at, expires_at, authoritative_product_credit, event_watermark, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM fbs_board_attr_event_v1 WHERE event_id = #{eventId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM fbs_board_attr_event_v1 WHERE receipt_id = #{receiptId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fbs_board_attr_journey_v1 (same_binding_key, contract_id, tenant_subject_digest, server_binding_id, journey_id, product_id, listed_manifest_version, embedded_contract_version, channel, terminal, host_version, traffic_class, intent_family, last_sequence_no, last_event_digest, head_version) VALUES (#{sameBindingKey}, #{contractId}, #{tenantSubjectDigest}, #{serverBindingId}, #{journeyId}, #{productId}, #{listedManifestVersion}, #{embeddedContractVersion}, #{channel}, #{terminal}, #{hostVersion}, #{trafficClass}, #{intentFamily}, #{lastSequenceNo}, #{lastEventDigest}, #{headVersion}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE same_binding_key = fbs_board_attr_journey_v1.same_binding_key
mapper.select: SELECT same_binding_key, contract_id, tenant_subject_digest, server_binding_id, journey_id, product_id, listed_manifest_version, embedded_contract_version, channel, terminal, host_version, traffic_class, intent_family, last_sequence_no, last_event_digest, head_version, created_at, updated_at FROM fbs_board_attr_journey_v1 WHERE same_binding_key = #{sameBindingKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fbs_board_attr_event_v1 (event_id, receipt_id, same_binding_key, contract_id, journey_id, server_binding_id, tenant_subject_digest, event_type, sequence_no, occurred_at, product_id, package_id, agent_name, marketplace, listed_surface, listed_manifest_version, embedded_contract_version, host_client_family, host_version, terminal, channel, request_source, intent_signal, intent_family, classification_source, classifier_version, confidence_bucket, review_mode, traffic_class, traffic_authority, outcome, previous_event_digest, traceparent, canonical_digest, event_digest, signer_key_id, signature_hex, nonce_hash, issued_at, expires_at, authoritative_product_credit) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{receiptId}, #{sameBindingKey}, #{contractId}, #{journeyId}, #{serverBindingId}, #{tenantSubjectDigest}, #{eventType}, #{sequenceNo}, #{occurredAt}, #{productId}, #{packageId}, #{agentName}, #{marketplace}, #{listedSurface}, #{listedManifestVersion}, #{embeddedContractVersion}, #{hostClientFamily}, #{hostVersion}, #{terminal}, #{channel}, #{requestSource}, #{intentSignal}, #{intentFamily}, #{classificationSource}, #{classifierVersion}, #{confidenceBucket}, #{reviewMode}, #{trafficClass}, #{trafficAuthority}, #{outcome}, #{previousEventDigest}, #{traceparent}, #{canonicalDigest}, #{eventDigest}, #{signerKeyId}, #{signatureHex}, #{nonceHash}, #{issuedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{productCreditEligible})
mapper.select: SELECT product_id, listed_manifest_version, channel, terminal, intent_family, review_mode, traffic_class, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'ENTRY_OBSERVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS entry_count, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'INTENT_CLASSIFIED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS classified_count, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'FIRST_VALUE_COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_value_count, COUNT(DISTINCT same_binding_key) AS distinct_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN intent_family = 'UNKNOWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unknown_debt_count, MAX(MAX(event_watermark)) OVER () AS event_high_watermark FROM fbs_board_attr_event_v1 WHERE occurred_at >= #{windowStart} AND occurred_at < #{windowEnd} AND (#{mode} = 'ALL' OR traffic_class = #{mode}) GROUP BY product_id, listed_manifest_version, channel, terminal, intent_family, review_mode, traffic_class ORDER BY traffic_class, channel, terminal, intent_family, review_mode LIMIT 500
